claim: Read actual S2MPG10 touch-supply control values through existing kernel ACPM read API without changing rails
oracle: Board-guarded helper reads L25M/L26M twice consistently, USB survives; no PMIC regulator/clock/modem drivers loaded

validation.user_journey: After failed physical touch, inspect supply state remotely; retain shell and known boot fallback; user need not tap again
code_reasoning: Load only mailbox and ACPM protocol; disable userspace module autoload temporarily
No sec-acpm or clk-acpm load, so built-in regulator consumers cannot be created by MFD
Helper contains read_reg calls only, channel2 speedychannel0 typePMIC1 per sec-acpm source
Watchdog and streamed logs protect module init; restore modprobe helper path after success
validation.unit: Compile and source write-operation prohibition checks; mocks cannot prove firmware or physical voltage
validation.end_to_end: kernelMailbox -> ACPM firmware -> PMIC read -> host log; check repeated values and freshSSH

evidence: Mailbox and ACPM protocol loaded under watchdog;15channels14usable. No sec_acpm or clk_acpm loaded; freshSSH and watchdog disarm passed. First helper rejected by board guard before reads: actualDT compatible google,gs101-oriole, not guessedgoogle,oriole. Correct exact guard from liveDT; no broadening togenericGS101.
limitations: Control values do not measure actual rail voltage
ACPM init changes volatile IPC/mailbox state; not a purely passive physical measurement
No touchscreen success inferred from supply state
exit_gate: No rail enable/voltage writes from this experiment; stop if unsupportedIPC, timeout, unexpected driver load or USB loss

result.limits: Register values only, no actual voltage measurement
